label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 27
text:
§ 27



The curative power of medicines, therefore, depends on their symptoms,
          similar to the disease but superior to it in strength (§ 12 - 26), so that each
          individual case of disease is most surely, radically, rapidly and permanently annihilated
          and removed only by a medicine capable of producing (in the human system) in the most
          similar and complete manner the totality of its symptoms, which at the same time are
          stronger than the disease.
